title: Build artifact retention expired
summary: Simulate a rollback needing an artifact that is no longer retained.

trigger.description: The most recent known-good build cannot be downloaded during recovery.

assumptions: Artifact retention is a recovery control, not a substitute for source history.
A release archive can be reviewed without production access.

inputs.name: retention_policy
inputs.description: Documented retention duration and archive owner.

score.formula: 100 minus a bounded rollback penalty when no retained artifact path is documented

recovery_actions: Test restoring a known-good artifact in an isolated environment.
Record an independent archive and expiry review.
limitations: Does not download artifacts or inspect storage accounts.
Does not claim that an archive is immutable.
